facts.text: "Number 5 has read every recipe in the library. This one tastes better than the book said. More, please."
facts.why: Johnny 5 never says this. It is in quote marks and signed Johnny 5, so it reads as a film line. His real lines are things like 'No disassemble!' and 'Need input!'.

facts.text: the lab canteen before the escape
facts.why: Attached to the Nova Robotics chilli cheese dogs. I could not confirm any canteen scene at Nova Robotics before Number 5 leaves. No plot page for this film could be opened (the Wikipedia link was refused), so I am going from the Wikiquote page only.
facts.fix: the Nova Robotics lab, before the lightning strike

vibe.verdict: A friendly lunch truck with the right robot nods, but it mostly ignores the funniest Number 5 scenes.
